name: ProteinLMBench
intro: ProteinLMBench是评估大型语言模型蛋白质理解能力的选择题基准。论文主文披露RAG先生成问题、选项与答案，再由GPT-4进行第二轮验证，丢弃两轮不一致题目后从1,000题得到944题；附录另称从超过10万条蛋白质问答池随机抽样，但未披露该说法与主文流程的先后顺序或抽样概率。
org: Toursun Synbio, Johns Hopkins University, University of Cambridge, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, UNSW Sydney
build_method: 按主文由RAG生成初始问题、选项与答案，GPT-4进行第二轮答案验证，丢弃不一致项后从1,000题得到944题；附录另记载超过10万问答池的随机抽样说法
task_type: 科学问答, 蛋白质任务
eval_feature: 论文目标格式为六选一并附正确答案解释，以Accuracy评测且无推荐数据划分；固定HF文件中871题为六项、73题为非六项
scale: 944题；主文记录1,000题经两轮一致性过滤后保留944题，附录另称从超过10万条问答池随机抽样
build_method_en: In the main text, RAG generates initial questions, choices, and answers, GPT-4 performs the second answer-validation round, and inconsistent items are discarded to reduce 1,000 questions to 944; the appendix separately reports random sampling from a greater-than-100K QA pool
eval_feature_en: The paper specifies six-choice items with correct-answer explanations, Accuracy, and no recommended split; the pinned HF file has 871 six-option rows and 73 non-six-option rows
intro_en: ProteinLMBench is a multiple-choice benchmark for LLM protein understanding. The main paper says RAG generates questions, choices, and answers, GPT-4 validates answers in the second round, and cross-round inconsistencies are discarded to reduce 1,000 questions to 944. The appendix separately says the benchmark was randomly sampled from a pool exceeding 100,000 protein QA pairs but does not disclose how that account is ordered relative to the main-text pipeline or any sampling probabilities.
scale_en: 944 questions; the main text reports 1,000 reduced to 944 by cross-round consistency filtering, while the appendix separately reports random sampling from a pool of more than 100,000 QA pairs

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18; source_stage=paper-and-official-release alignment; scope=ProteinLMBench only. The primary paper is pinned to https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.05540v2 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2406.05540v2. The reviewed PDF SHA256 is 161a6e71e4e3321c91bd884ab2c906704c9110dbd5d3672651689e9369ca98dd. The official dataset snapshot is pinned to https://huggingface.co/datasets/tsynbio/ProteinLMBench/tree/f1397963c7f727a4a2f00cdd691e6e219c36e992. At that revision, README.md SHA256 is f9e0b3f2696c88de34986dc7b7c4d177c381fb38c84b688a993231649713add4, ProteinLMBench.json SHA256 is f2dce5c1b54e8ce73897a4af48ae8ba05507076d511b9d02d57cddf31c42ed96, and ProteinLMBench.csv SHA256 is a31772039d0c3601e7dfaa402cdcaf44587d0fc5f17179c304c0aa8d031e29fc. The graph separates two disclosures that the paper does not reconcile into one ordered pipeline. Main-text Section 4.3 describes a two-round scheme: RAG generates the initial questions, choices, and answers; GPT-4 validates the answers; questions with inconsistencies between the rounds are discarded; and 1,000 initial questions become 944. The appendix separately says ProteinLMBench is randomly sampled from a dataset of more than 100,000 protein-related question-answer pairs because manpower limits scaling. The appendix does not disclose the sampling order, sampling probabilities, seed, or how the greater-than-100K account relates temporally to the main-text 1,000-question stage. The diagram therefore does not fabricate a serial edge between those accounts. Validation attribution is also bounded. The main text names RAG and GPT-4. The appendix says machines and humans validated the questions, but it does not identify the human validators as paper authors. The previous author-validation wording is removed. The paper defines 944 manually annotated six-choice questions, each with an explanation of the correct answer, spanning protein property prediction, protein descriptions, and protein sequence understanding. It recommends no train, validation, or test split and evaluates with Accuracy. The pinned JSON has exactly 944 rows and fields question, options, answer, and explanation. A direct cardinality audit finds 871 six-option rows and 73 non-six-option rows. The complete non-six distribution is three rows with 2 options, twenty-one with 3, forty-two with 4, one with 5, two with 7, one with 8, and three with 10. This file fact is not silently rewritten to satisfy the paper's six-choice description, and the paper description is not silently rewritten to match the file deviation. HF metadata declares Apache-2.0 for the package. No recommended split, sampling seed, probabilistic design, author-review workflow, judge model, or alternative scoring formula is inferred. The solid path is limited to the paper's RAG generation, GPT-4 validation, cross-round consistency filtering, 944-item contract, model answer comparison, and Accuracy report. Dashed paths carry fixed evidence, the appendix sampling account, attribution limits, the pinned HF snapshot, option-cardinality drift, and the package license. English and Chinese specs use identical semantic IDs, types, positions, edge types, styles, waypoints, and modules; every secondary edge explicitly sets dashed=true and no edge has a label. Source-stage fallback fields remain unregistered and empty. Formal Draw.io, architecture JSON, SVG, PNG, catalog, manifest, and synchronization outputs are intentionally unchanged in this source-stage handoff.
